of.needed: whether the static configuration file sets providers.consul.tls.caOptional

consequence.statement: The `tls.caOptional` option in Consul provider static configuration has been removed in v3.0.0 and is no longer honoured.
consequence.remediation: Remove the `tls.caOptional` option from the Consul provider static configuration (file or `--providers.consul.tls.caOptional` CLI flag).

evidence.excerpt:
#### TLS.CAOptional

Consul provider `tls.CAOptional` option has been removed in v3, as TLS client authentication is a server side option (see https://pkg.go.dev/crypto/tls#ClientAuthType).

??? example "An example usage of the TLS.CAOptional option"

    ```yaml tab="File (YAML)"
    providers:
      consul:
        tls: 
          caOptional: true
    ```

    ```toml tab="File (TOML)"
    [providers.consul.tls]
        caOptional=true
    ```

    ```bash tab="CLI"
    --providers.consul.tls.caOptional=true
    ```
